subject: general
question: Which of the following molecules has only single bonds?
solution:
The correct answer is __CH4__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**To know the nature of bonds, we will note the valency of different atoms in the molecule or compound and then draw their structures.

 
• O2: Oxygen atoms are connected to each other by a **double bond** as the valency of oxygen atom is 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0e3fb3d06d9470cd7bc0ae0fee3b94846dc3efc003520306e48757b3ff59dd.png] 

 
• CH4: Carbon has a valency of 4, thus 4 H are connected to the single carbon with the help of **4 single bonds**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7159fcbead3f16cc22217d6ccbd84e5db0920601ae39c1028bdaf44c19566951.png] 

 
• N₂: Nitrogen is a diatomic linear molecule which is connected through a **triple bond**, because nitrogen atom has a valency of 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1c1252f31e6286201941cc59b7e61f1d8a8176deb72977ffc72ea1f680caab6.png] 

 
• CO₂: In carbon dioxide, the valency of Carbon is 4, while the valency of oxygen atoms is 2. Thus, the carbon will be joined to oxygens through **2 double bonds** as shown below: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c646a2726bc9531cbb45ef38f14aaaa23046b5502bcfd50b65d0955accb980.png] 

 

***Thus, only CH4 has single bond present.***
